title: smilacina racemosa var. jenkinsii
intro: Smilacina racemosa var. jenkinsii, commonly known as green false Solomon's seal, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family native to North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of green false Solomon's seal include its ability to act as a demulcent, protecting mucous membranes, and its potential to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include smilagenin and smilacin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
